scope: Finite semantic review of every non-company/startup record in the fresh 1020-organisation snapshot. No new candidates, imports, removals or live edits.

criteria.investors: Explicit investment mandates and technical financing networks qualify without own products. Portfolio sectors alone do not justify topics.
criteria.institutions: Distinct research units, universities, technical nonprofits, technical communities and research/startup hubs are assessed by their actual role, not the company product rule.
criteria.topics: Retain supported specific topics; no speculative additions. climate-tech means Energy. Parent and descendant keys must not coexist.
criteria.activity: A live page, a copyright year or a successful fetch is not proof of recent activity. Distinguish dated programmes from undated public descriptions. No removal for silence or retrieval failure.

outsideScope.decision: Preserve explicit user approval. Company record is not one of these 114; no reclassification or removal proposed.

topicless.decision: Preserve all 13 broad investor/university/community records without invented tags.

outOfScope.decision: Existing identity hold belongs to company/startup review; not resolved by this audit.
Preserve explicit exclusion from classification; no tag or field changes.

duplicateReview.method: Compared exact website identities across all 1020 records, then reviewed named parent/unit and successor relationships. Exact URL matching alone is not a proof of universal deduplication.

decisions.decision: Distinct D-ITET biomedical-imaging lab and D-INFK geometric-vision group; preserve both.
Parent university and separately named centres/institutes; CAI is not IDS or InIT. January 2027 CAI institute transition is future, not a current rename.

Successor to Procedural; no separate Procedural production row found.

Independent commercial AG produces diffusive air-pollution samplers and performs accredited analysis. Retain eligibility; propose Lab to Company for consistency, preserving topics and relationships.

questions.decision: Retain technical-investor eligibility; current operating activity remains unconfirmed.
questions.question: Is the Swiss operation still actively investing or managing its portfolio under this mandate?
questions.evidence: Official technology/healthcare theses and Meilen contact remain published; highlighted dated news stops in 2022. Homepage, topic pages, updates and targeted official-domain search were checked. No affirmative closure evidence found.

limitations: Reviewed means a reasoned per-record role/classification decision, not independent proof that every organisation is operational today. Each row explicitly records its activity-evidence level.
Dated 2026 programmes and publications establish observable current output or scheduled activity, not legal good standing, solvency or staffing verification.
Reused topicless and four mandate decisions date from 2026-10-14; they were substantively reconciled, not freshly refetched.

Several ETH homepages yielded navigation/contact shells; research subpages, indexed official text and prior institute reviews were used. ETH IWF recent research output was not independently dated in this pass.
CSEM national technical remit is verified, but allocation of all listed semiconductor/embedded activities to Zurich personnel is not independently recertified.
Direct Empa retrieval was WAF-blocked; indexed official research pages and 2026 publication/event evidence were available.
No addresses, social accounts, logos or live classifications were modified; this is not a full legal-register audit.
